verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents its own transfer-in capability: an API transfer-in operation, a transfer page with bulk submission of up to 500 domains and an option to pause the transfer until DNS is set up, a GoDaddy migration guide, and signed webhooks for transfer events that support status tracking. The evidence never describes the EPP/auth-code step, transfer pricing, or whether remaining registration time carries over, so most of the 'honest' disclosure parts of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: EPP/auth-code flow documentation, transfer cost disclosure, treatment of remaining registration time, explicit transfer status views, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, transferring domains IN is documented and honest — EPP/auth-code flow, status tracking, what the transfer costs, and what happens to remaining registration time
